newsitem.title: UK: Barclays sells global custody business.
newsitem.headline: Barclays sells global custody business.

text.p: British banking giant Barclays Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed the sale of its global institutional custody business, with about $250 billion of administered assets, to Morgan Stanley Group Inc.
Barclays said in a statement that the exact consideration would be fixed over a period.
But the deal, which is expected to be completed by the beginning of the second quarter of 1997, was not expected to have a material effect on Barclays consolidated accounts.

"Approximately $250 billion of assets currently administered by BGSS (Barclays Global Securities Services) are involved in the transaction which is expected to be completed by the beginning of the second quarter of 1997," the company stated.
